name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations: surface, underground or elevated; five lengths and optional approach fences.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.13.2 adds Elevated as a third station location. Elevated tracks sit 12m above ground on a concrete deck with crossbeams and piers. One ground-level entrance centred along the station branches to two visible stair flights and both platforms. Rigid closed concrete geometry with native unskinned concrete material forms 122 treads, two supporting stair waists and the viaduct; there is no raised terrain embankment. Platform and stair safety railings remain when optional approach fencing is disabled. Elevated is available as a through station or terminus in all five platform lengths (40/60/80/100/120m). Termini always have a crossover; through stations never do. Existing surface/underground stations and saved parameter values remain unchanged. The user confirmed all 0.12.0 lengths work; Elevated 0.13.0 had missing standalone skinned bridge surfaces and a placement collision. This update uses rigid closed geometry, visual-only entrance floor/porch, and 10.4m beam clearance. The ground street snap frame now follows the entrance frontage rather than the rail-end direction, with a 1m inset to the public walking node. This requires a new in-game placement and street-link test. Start on level ground, connect a street at the central ground entrance and electric tramtrack on bridges at +12m. Base station prices and capacity are unchanged for this prototype. Do not remove the mod while its infrastructure remains in a save.
